info.name: E-Commerce & Inventory System - Capstone API Tests
info.description: Automated test suite for the Option 4 E-Commerce and Inventory Management System. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or Newman). Run 'npm run seed' before every full run because the suite places orders, redeems a single-use coupon and creates reviews. Uses collection variables: baseUrl, accessToken, refreshToken, productId, orderId (plus helper variables set by the scripts).

exec: pm.test('Role is customer and password is not leaked', () => { pm.expect(j.data.user.role).to.eql('customer'); pm.expect(j.data.user).to.not.have.property('password'); });

item.name: Register with role=admin is ignored (privilege escalation blocked)
Re-using the old refresh token -> 401 (theft detection)

exec: pm.test('Reused refresh token rejected with 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Exactly one match for ELEC-001', () => { pm.expect(j.data).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.data[0].sku).to.eql('ELEC-001'); });

pm.test('Product exposes stock, threshold and rating fields', () => { const p = j.data[0]; pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.lowStockThreshold).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.numReviews).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Exactly one match for BOOK-004', () => { pm.expect(j.data).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.data[0].sku).to.eql('BOOK-004'); });

item.name: Filter by category + price range, sort price_desc

exec: pm.test('All results are Electronics priced 1000-5000', () => { pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); j.data.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.category).to.eql('Electronics'); pm.expect(p.price).to.be.within(1000, 5000); }); });
pm.test('Results sorted by price descending', () => { for (let i = 1; i < j.data.length; i++) { pm.expect(j.data[i - 1].price).to.be.at.least(j.data[i].price); } });

pm.test('Page metadata is correct', () => { pm.expect(j.pagination.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.pagination.limit).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.pagination.total).to.be.at.least(26); pm.expect(j.pagination.pages).to.be.at.least(6); });
pm.test('At most 5 items on the page', () => pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.most(5));
pm.test('Coupon is valid (code matched case-insensitively)', () => { pm.expect(d.valid).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.code).to.eql('WELCOME10'); });
pm.test('10% discount is capped by maxDiscountAmount (200)', () => pm.expect(d.discountAmount).to.eql(200));
pm.test('Coupon not valid: minimum order not met', () => { pm.expect(d.valid).to.be.false; pm.expect(d.message).to.include('minimum'); pm.expect(d.discountAmount).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Coupon not valid: unknown code', () => { pm.expect(d.valid).to.be.false; pm.expect(d.message).to.include('Invalid coupon code'); });

item.name: BIGSALE25 on 2 units, discount capped at 1000

exec: pm.test('Coupon valid for a 3000+ cart', () => { pm.expect(d.valid).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.subtotal).to.be.at.least(3000); });
pm.test('Order starts as pending with one history entry', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(o.statusHistory).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test('Coupon applied and capped at 200', () => { pm.expect(o.couponCode).to.eql('WELCOME10'); pm.expect(o.discountAmount).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('Totals are consistent (price snapshot x qty - discount)', () => { pm.expect(o.subtotal).to.eql(o.items[0].price * 2); pm.expect(o.totalAmount).to.eql(o.subtotal - o.discountAmount); });

item.name: Same coupon again -> 400 (single use per user)

exec: pm.test('Message says already used', () => pm.expect(j.message).to.include('already used'));
pm.test('Error lists requested vs available units', () => { pm.expect(j.errors[0].requested).to.eql(99999); pm.expect(j.errors[0].available).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Missing shipping address -> 400 (validated before touching stock)
Stock unchanged after the failed checkouts

exec: pm.test('Failed checkouts did not change stock', () => pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('stockAfterOrder'))));

item.name: Checkout 1 unit without coupon (to be cancelled)

exec: pm.test('Order is cancelled and stock restored flag is set', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(o.stockRestored).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Stock is back to the value after the first order', () => pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('stockAfterOrder'))));

item.name: My orders contain the new order

exec: pm.test('Newest orders are listed first and include the coupon order', () => pm.expect(j.data.some(o => o._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('Review stores rating and is flagged as verified purchase', () => { pm.expect(r.rating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(r.isVerifiedPurchase).to.be.true; });

body.raw: {"rating":5,"title":"Great earbuds","comment":"Clear sound and long battery life."}

item.name: Second review on the same product -> 409

exec: pm.test('Validation error points at the rating field', () => { pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'); pm.expect(j.errors.some(e => e.field === 'rating')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Rating and title updated', () => { pm.expect(r.rating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(r.title).to.eql('Good earbuds'); });
pm.test('Our review is listed', () => pm.expect(j.data.some(r => r._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('reviewId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Product rating recalculated by the review:updated event

exec: pm.test('numReviews is back to the original value', () => pm.expect(p.numReviews).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('numReviewsBefore'))));
pm.test('Wishlist contains the product', () => pm.expect(j.data.items.some(i => i.product._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Recommendations: personalized for a customer with history

exec: pm.test('Strategy is personalized and categories come from orders', () => { pm.expect(d.strategy).to.eql('personalized'); pm.expect(d.preferredCategories).to.include.members(['Electronics', 'Books']); });

pm.test('Non-empty, in stock, each with a reason', () => { pm.expect(d.recommendations.length).to.be.above(0); d.recommendations.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(p.reason).to.be.a('string'); }); });
pm.test('Already purchased products are excluded', () => d.recommendations.forEach(p => pm.expect(purchased).to.not.include(p.sku)));

item.name: Recommendations: fallback for a brand-new user

exec: pm.test('Strategy is fallback with no preferred categories', () => { pm.expect(d.strategy).to.eql('fallback'); pm.expect(d.preferredCategories).to.have.length(0); });

pm.test('Top-rated products returned in descending rating order', () => { pm.expect(d.recommendations.length).to.be.above(0); for (let i = 1; i < d.recommendations.length; i++) { pm.expect(d.recommendations[i - 1].averageRating).to.be.at.least(d.recommendations[i].averageRating); } });
pm.test('SKU stored in uppercase, stock above threshold', () => { pm.expect(p.sku).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newSku').toUpperCase()); pm.expect(p.isLowStock).to.be.false; });

item.name: Update product (stock drops below threshold; averageRating write is ignored)

exec: pm.test('Price and stock updated, low-stock flag raised', () => { pm.expect(p.price).to.eql(1099); pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(4); pm.expect(p.isLowStock).to.be.true; });
pm.test('averageRating cannot be set by the client (mass-assignment blocked)', () => pm.expect(p.averageRating).to.eql(0));
pm.test('Updated product is in the low-stock list', () => pm.expect(j.data.some(p => p._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('newProductId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('Every listed product is at or below its threshold', () => j.data.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.at.most(p.lowStockThreshold)));
pm.test('Message lists the allowed next statuses', () => pm.expect(j.message).to.include('confirmed'));
pm.test('Status is confirmed with 2 history entries', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(o.statusHistory).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('Status is delivered and deliveredAt is set', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('delivered'); pm.expect(o.deliveredAt).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Deleted product is hidden from the public catalogue

exec: pm.test('Code stored in uppercase, no redemptions yet', () => { pm.expect(c.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCouponCode').toUpperCase()); pm.expect(c.usedCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(c.usedBy).to.have.length(0); });
pm.test('discountValue changed but the code did not', () => { pm.expect(c.discountValue).to.eql(20); pm.expect(c.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCouponCode').toUpperCase()); });
pm.test('Revenue and order totals are numeric', () => { pm.expect(d.totalRevenue).to.be.a('number').above(0); pm.expect(d.totalOrders).to.be.at.least(30); });

pm.test('Top 5 products sorted by units sold', () => { pm.expect(d.topProducts).to.have.length(5); for (let i = 1; i < d.topProducts.length; i++) { pm.expect(d.topProducts[i - 1].unitsSold).to.be.at.least(d.topProducts[i].unitsSold); } });

pm.test('Coupon redemption stats include WELCOME10', () => { pm.expect(d.couponStats.totalCoupons).to.be.at.least(6); pm.expect(d.couponStats.byCoupon.some(c => c.code === 'WELCOME10')).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Grouped by day, periods ascending', () => { pm.expect(d.groupBy).to.eql('day'); pm.expect(d.series.length).to.be.above(0); d.series.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.period).to.match(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/)); for (let i = 1; i < d.series.length; i++) { pm.expect(d.series[i - 1].period < d.series[i].period).to.be.true; } });
pm.test('averageOrderValue = revenue / orderCount', () => d.series.forEach(s => pm.expect(Math.abs(s.averageOrderValue - s.revenue / s.orderCount)).to.be.below(0.02)));
pm.test('Summary order count equals the sum of the series', () => pm.expect(d.summary.totalOrders).to.eql(d.series.reduce((a, s) => a + s.orderCount, 0)));

pm.test('Periods are YYYY-MM and span at least 2 months', () => { pm.expect(d.groupBy).to.eql('month'); pm.expect(d.series.length).to.be.at.least(2); d.series.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.period).to.match(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$/)); });
pm.test('Discounts and revenue are numeric', () => d.series.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.revenue).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(s.totalDiscounts).to.be.a('number'); }));

pm.test('All 6 seeded categories present, Electronics sold units', () => { pm.expect(d.categories.length).to.be.at.least(6); const e = d.categories.find(c => c.category === 'Electronics'); pm.expect(e).to.exist; pm.expect(e.unitsSold).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Net revenue never exceeds gross revenue', () => d.categories.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.netRevenue).to.be.at.most(c.grossRevenue + 0.01)));

pm.test('Inventory fields present and low-stock items counted', () => { d.categories.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c.currentStock).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(c.inventoryValuation).to.be.a('number'); }); pm.expect(d.totals.lowStockItems).to.be.at.least(5); });
pm.test('Totals equal the sum of categories', () => pm.expect(d.totals.unitsSold).to.eql(d.categories.reduce((a, c) => a + c.unitsSold, 0)));
pm.test('Revoked refresh token rejected with 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
